description.value: The Bedford Regency is a 40-room European-style boutique hotel housed in one of Victoria's cherished heritage buildings near Bastion Square, with roots going back to the Garrick's Head Saloon of 1867. It sits on Government Street in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, Royal BC Museum, and Beacon Hill Park. Two on-site English pubs — Garrick's Head Pub and The Churchill — serve traditional pub fare and nearly one hundred craft and import beers.

address.value: 1140 Government Street, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada
